description: This file defines a media understanding provider for Moonshot AI, including functions to describe videos using Moonshot's API, and exports a provider object with capabilities and methods.

methods.name: resolveModel
methods.description: Resolves the model name, defaulting if input is undefined or whitespace.

methods.name: resolvePrompt
methods.description: Resolves the prompt string, defaulting if input is undefined or whitespace.

methods.name: coerceMoonshotText
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates text content from Moonshot API payload.

methods.name: describeMoonshotVideo
methods.description: Main function to send a video description request to Moonshot API and process the response.
